## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] New source files start with the SPDX license identifier and a copyright line
- [ ] Code is formatted with clang-format
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or the summary explains why none are needed
- [ ] `docs/design.md` is updated if this changes a recorded decision
- [ ] Public API changes keep the C ABI compatible, or are listed in the changelog
